name: every last animation
did: Every one of the fifty skeletal clips rebuilt. The walk and the run had both feet permanently behind the pelvis; the locomotion cycles are generated from the foot's path now, so a planted foot is planted and nothing goes through the floor. Fifty-nine keyframes bent an elbow backwards. The sampler no longer interpolates in straight lines, so no joint snaps to a new speed at every key.
onAccept: The armoury reloads. Your loadouts are kept; anything you had equipped that moved class is still where you left it.
